title: One Week Study
description: This template provides speed information for a route or corridor across a single week — the synthetic drive-through, at percentile speeds.
_note:
Reconstructed via `--from-page 2210438` against the pre-existing convert_old_reports.py-built page, corrected by hand against the live section data. Adopted 2026-08-11 by deleting the old page and rebuilding fresh under the same slug, per Ryan's direction (no --update bootstrap capability built for that — see report-spec-and-build-script.md's Dynamic Report follow-on). Both Bar Graph Summary panels (daily_bar/avg_bar) added back 2026-08-11 once graphType:BarGraph resolution:summary was built (same doc) — this is now the full 7-panel page, nothing dropped. Route names ('Today', 'N Days Ago') are stale relative-to-real-wall-clock-today labels that don't reflect a viewer-picked base date — a known, flagged, not-yet-fixed issue, same doc.

ADDED 2026-08-13, Ryan's live hand-by-hand comparison against the old tool (template 276): added `weekday_info_box` (see below) — the 8th real graph (graph-idx-1 in the old template's gap log) that had never once been rebuilt into any spec, dropped rather than genuinely blocked. Confirmed the 2 Bar Graph Summary panels Ryan suspected were also missing are in fact both already live and correct (daily_bar: 5 bars, avg_bar: 3 bars) — verified directly against both the old and new pages side by side, nothing to fix there. This same rebuild also picks up every compose-layer fix made 2026-08-12 that this page had never been rebuilt to receive: the TMC_IDENTIFICATION_JOIN(3464)->META_JOIN(983) metadata-join unification, the GridGraph/single-route-BarGraph rdylgn color-scale fix (was showing the old ~20-swatch route-identity 'confetti' palette on year_grid), and the LineGraph tooltip fixes (getTooltipFormatFunc rounding, conditional Line Total) — none of those are spec changes, they're compose-time fixes in composeMeasureConfig.js/GraphComponent.jsx that only take effect on the next --publish.

graphs.title: Route Info Box, Speed, Travel Time
graphs.why: Recovered 2026-08-13 (Ryan's call) — the old template's real Info Box (graph-idx-1, dropped from every spec build to date; gap log confirms it's the only graph never rebuilt), one row per weekday. The old panel also had Average-for-Week/Month/Year rows in the SAME table — that's the still-unbuilt mixed-resolution-in-one-table gap, so scoped down to the 5 weekday rows only, which need no new mechanism: each weekday is already its own distinct route (r1..r5), not one route reused, so this doesn't hit the per-route-multiple-times gap. Multi-measure Info Box (speed+travelTime) was built 2026-08-12 but never actually applied to the one template it was scoped around.

graphs.title: Route Line Graph, Speed
graphs.why: Overlays each of the 5 daily comps (4/3/2 days ago, yesterday, today) as its own 5-minute speed profile across the day.

graphs.title: One Week Study — Speed
graphs.why: Every comp (5 days + week/month/year averages) as its own choropleth layer, matching the old panel's per-comp Map fan-out.

graphs.title: Bar Graph Summary, Speed
graphs.why: One bar per daily comp (4/3/2 days ago, yesterday, today) — the whole-window speed average for each, side by side, matching the old panel's shape.

graphs.title: Route Line Graph, Speed (Averages)
graphs.why: The week/month/year average comps as their own overlaid 5-minute profiles, same shape as daily_line.

graphs.title: Bar Graph Summary, Speed
graphs.why: One bar per week/month/year-average comp — same shape as daily_bar, for the 3 longer-window comps.

graphs.title: TMC Grid Graph, Speed
graphs.why: Per-TMC speed grid for the Average-for-Year comp only, matching the live page's single GridGraph assignment.

graphs.title: Route Map, Speed
graphs.why: A second, single Route Map fed by every comp — matches the live page's second Map section.
